title: Moroccan Style Pan-Seared Fish
description: A flavorful and spicy Moroccan-inspired dish made with pan-seared fish, served with a variety of sides.

ingredients.name: Fish fillets (4)
ingredients.notes: any white fish, such as tilapia or mahi-mahi

ingredients.name: Moroccan spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most spice stores or online

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Add the garlic and ginger to the skillet and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the fish fillets to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the skillet and place on a plate.
Reduce heat to medium and add the Moroccan spice mix to the skillet.
Stir for 1 minute and then squeeze in the lemon juice.
Serve the fish with the spicy sauce spooned over the top.
